text: On the night of his engagement, the student Shirō sits beside his colleague Tamura as [their car kills a yakuza leader|wrong|an accident and its guilt] and Tamura keeps driving. [The dead man's mother vows to kill them|wants|revenge for a wrong], and guilt follows Shirō to his father's retirement community, where [rancid fish and poisoned wine|ending|everyone dies] finish every resident at a single party. In Hell, judged by Lord Enma, he searches among the boiled and flayed for the baby daughter [bound to a great torture wheel|images|ropes, cages and executions].
